name: Ming Shing Group Holdings Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of wet trades such as plastering, brickwork, wall and floor tiling, painting and decoration, floor screeding, and marble works. The firm also involves in construction, renovation, maintenance, addition, and alteration of buildings in mainly residential and commercial segments, as well as industrial buildings, government buildings, community facilities transportation, and public infrastructure. The company was founded on August 2, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
